selection_scope: Six curated completed-answer illustrations. No aggregate performance or accuracy statistics are derived from this selection.
selection_method: Inspected a one-second contact sheet, then original-resolution frames; refined narrow completion intervals using exact zero-based source frame indices and ffprobe PTS.

extraction.evidence_edits: None: no crop, resize, annotations, retouching, or text substitution. Normal ffmpeg YUV-to-RGB decoding for lossless PNG output.
extraction.inspection_only: Inspection crops and contact sheets remained private and are not the six selected full-frame evidence PNGs.

visible_settings.sampling_parameters_note: These sampling settings are not visible in the selected recording frames; do not infer them from pixels.

caveats: The live preview can be newer than the sampled image that produced the displayed answer. Selected frames show the same object family, but do not prove pixel-identical inference inputs.

Display timings are UI values, rounded as shown. Frame age updates independently; at console completion it reads 1.94 s while Complete answer reads 1.96 s. Preserve these visible values rather than repairing their ordering.
RAM is system shared memory including the OS and applications, not a dedicated model VRAM allocation.
Camera preview frame rate and skipped-frame counts are not model throughput or error counts.
The curated examples are illustrations, not a random sample or a paired benchmark.
Objects described in the final console sequence may be a replica; the observed limitation concerns an unsupported specific Color label, not verified device internals.

limits: These are values visibly rounded by the browser UI in a user recording, not server-side timing measurements or a controlled benchmark.
Each completed response is counted once using the visible completed counter. The first completion can belong to a request that began before the clip.

CPU, GPU and shared RAM ranges come from 492 video samples at nominal 10 Hz. The UI telemetry refreshes more slowly, so repeated screen samples are not independent resource measurements and can miss peaks.
Shared RAM covers system memory used by the OS and applications, not a dedicated model VRAM allocation. It must not be added to CPU RAM as a separate pool.
Camera frame rate and skipped-frame counters are not inference throughput or failed requests.
Live preview frames can be newer than the inference input. No selected screenshot proves pixel-identical correspondence between the current preview and the displayed answer.
The selected view shows the Live VLM WebUI preset and 1280×720 camera/sent dimensions; max tokens, temperature, top-k and top-p controls are not visible in these frames.
Actual generated-token counts, exact historical request payloads, backend health, OOM events and end-to-end accuracy cannot be established from the recording.
The six curated examples are illustrations, not a random quality sample. Specific brand, color and handheld-model claims can be unsupported or vary between adjacent answers.
“After” and “opted for accuracy” are the user’s recording labels. This material does not establish a causal before/after latency gain or an accuracy gain.

This clip belongs after restoration of the original corrected FP16 runtime following the rejected sampler experiment and before the new MLP optimization goal. It does not depict the later MLP candidate.
